content:
I came to Hippocrates Wellness as a "supporter" of my husband who has health challenges.

I have to say I feel in love with HHI, the food, the therapies and the people. I really didn't want to come home. It is a paradise. I have told everyone I know about this wonderful secret. More people need to know about HHI. I need magazines to hand out and promote this incrediable get away. I can't wait to come back. It will be sooner than you think ! God willing and the river don't rise......God bless Hippocrates Wellness !
